steps.label: Prompt
steps.text:
Make a 20-second product demo for [your product], 16:9 at 1920x1080, from the "30-best-replies-mcp" template in lumian2015/opus-5-5-video-templates (MIT, rendered with HyperFrames).

Setup: clone https://github.com/lumian2015/opus-5-5-video-templates into ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates, then run `npx hyperframes@0.8.96 doctor` and fix anything it reports (it needs Node.js 22 or newer, FFmpeg and Chrome).

The film, scene by scene:
1. a post with a video preview; the camera pulls back into a wall of replies and the reply count turns red
2. hook: 60 replies. Which ones matter?
3. an AI agent window with the MCP connected pill; the prompt is typed and sent
4. two tool calls run with live progress (collect, then refine) and turn green
5. a grid of replies filters down to the kept ones while the counter rolls; 'replies' becomes 'kept.'
6. one kept reply flies up and gets an 'It made it.' stamp with a drawn ring and sparks
7. four more replies swap in with slides and 3D flips, highlighted phrases in red
8. spotlight, red carpet, gold border, 'Best reply' badge and confetti for the best one
9. Any agent. Any stack., MCP, CLI and API panels, which fly apart into a warm flare
10. end card: flame mark, wordmark, tagline, button and domain over rising embers

Before you change anything, learn [your product] from [your product URL] and ask me only for what you cannot find: its name, what it does in one line, the copy each scene needs, and two or three brand colours as #rrggbb. The demo brand, names, prices, numbers, ratings and quotes are placeholders: replace every one with something true for my product, or remove it. Never ship a made-up number or testimonial.

Then:
1. `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/new-video.mjs 30-best-replies-mcp my-video`
2. `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/vars.mjs my-video` to list the variables.
3. Write values.json, keeping each value close to its default's length and format (the same number of |-separated items, plain numbers where the default is a number), then apply it with `node ~/.claude/skills/opus-5-5-video-templates/scripts/vars.mjs my-video values.json`.
4. `cd my-video && npx hyperframes@0.8.96 snapshot --at 1,7,13,19`, look at every frame, and fix any text that overflows or any colour that is hard to read.
5. `npx hyperframes@0.8.96 render -f 60 -q high -w 4 -o out.mp4`, then watch it through once before you hand it over.

Template notes: Replies are 'Name | handle | text'; words in [brackets] are highlighted (red, or gold for the best reply). Keep replies, collected and kept consistent. The small cards in the wall and the filter grid draw from the FIRST, LAST and LINES lists in the script. The CLI and API panels are generated from brand, domain, tool names, target and criterion. Replies may contain emoji; they render with the system emoji font, so check a frame when rendering on Linux.
